name: pages
about: Create a page, give it a title, add a to-do line. Starts from an open console and leaves it open.

params.walk_tag: a short tag unique to this walk, e.g. the merge's short sha: it names what the walk makes so a later run can find it

gaps: ducktape-views@a2a73e1 pages/src/pages.rs:568 — title and body are one Editor with no label and no value in the tree: typed text shows only through the toolbar title label
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 pages/src/editor_binding.rs:496 — a to-do checkbox is painted inside the editor: no CheckBox node, so checking it cannot be done or proven from the tree
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 pages/src/editor_binding.rs:402-407,557 — undo is Ctrl/Cmd+Z only, no Undo button: the pointer door has no key, so undo is not walked
ducktape-views@a2a73e1 pages/src/rows.rs:371 — search result rows are unnamed buttons; rows.rs:127-133 row actions show only on hover

steps.say: open the Pages tab in the rail
steps.expect: the Pages tab is selected and the pages view shows a New page button; no failure state (no failure title such as 'This network does not list this view', no Retry button) and it is not still loading
a new page opens: the toolbar title label reads Untitled and the page list has an Untitled row; no error

steps.say: type the title into the page document editor
steps.expect: the toolbar title label reads QA walk {param:walk_tag} and the page list has a row named QA walk {param:walk_tag}

steps.say: type a new line with a to-do item into the page document editor
steps.expect: the save status label reads Saving… or Saved (not Not saved); no error
